# ZeroC.Expat

This package provides the [Expat] debug and release DLLs, their corresponding import libraries, and the Expat header
files.

It was originally created for use with ZeroC Ice Windows builds, but it can be used in any C or C++ project that
requires Expat.

## Source Code

Expat is used unmodified. The MSBuild project, nuspec and targets used to produce this package are available on
GitHub, alongside the source URL and checksum for the upstream release the binaries were built from:

👉 https://github.com/zeroc-ice/ice/tree/main/packaging/third-party/windows

[Expat]: https://libexpat.github.io/
